samples.evidence: editor.ts:3652 already implements exactly this read (`getSelectedImage()`: null-check selectedImage → resolve block → `findImageAtOffset` → return {data, blockId, offset}). The new provider at editor.ts:2256 repeats it verbatim except it returns the key as `image` and resolves with `doc.findBlock` instead of `doc.getBlock`. The two have already diverged on the very hazard the new comment calls load-bearing ("`findBlock`, not `getBlock`: the latter throws") — the public `getSelectedImage()` still uses the throwing lookup. One private helper used by both would keep a single answer to "what image is selected".

samples.summary: Mod-key/platform detection re-implemented instead of reusing the existing one
samples.evidence: `/Mac|iPhone|iPad|iPod/.test(navigator.platform)` plus the meta-vs-ctrl choice is copied from text-editor.ts:874-875 (and the repo already has packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/platform.ts for the frontend side). The new handler in editor.ts must stay in lockstep with `TextEditor.handleKeyDown`'s notion of the mod key — the diff's own comment about key normalization says as much — yet the logic is a third copy rather than an exported helper.

samples.summary: Context-menu Copy still hidden when only an image is selected, so the #870 outcome is keyboard-only
samples.evidence: `hasSelection = !!editor.getActiveSelection()` (docs-context-menu.tsx:74) reflects the *text* selection only; a click-selected image leaves it false, so `showCopy` is false and the right-click menu offers no Copy over a selected image — even though `editor.copy()` (editor.ts:3333, execCommand → handleCopy) would now work through the new `imageSelectionProvider`. The keyboard path is fixed, the menu path is not, so the same user-visible action still "copies nothing" via right-click.

samples.summary: Read-only Copy menu change is unrelated scope, and contradicts the context-menu design doc without updating it
samples.evidence: The `hasClipboardGroup = !readOnly || hasSelection` / `showCopy = hasSelection` change addresses neither #870 (image copy) nor #872 (table-cell copy fidelity); it is a separate read-only-menu behaviour change riding along. docs/design/docs/docs-context-menu.md:23 documents the group as "Cut / Copy (selection-gated) and Paste" and :56 states the menu "returns without opening ... (so read-only / nothing-to-offer right-clicks show neither an overlay nor the native menu)" — read-only right-clicks with a selection now do open an overlay, and the doc was not updated.

samples.summary: Cell resolution for a clipboard extraction goes through the layout when the model already answers it
samples.evidence: `getSelectedBlocks()` now resolves the owning cell via `layout.blockParentMap` + `resolveNestedTableLayout(...).dataBlock.tableData`. The model layer already does exactly this walk without any layout dependency — packages/src/model/range-slices.ts:162-175 uses `doc.blockParentMap` + `doc.findBlock(tableBlockId)?.tableData?.rows[r].cells[c]`. Copying content is a model concern; binding it to a rendered layout means a stale/absent layout silently yields an empty clipboard payload, and it adds a second cell-resolution idiom to maintain.

samples.summary: Image copy writes no flavour any external application can consume
samples.evidence: `writeImageToClipboard` sets only `WAFFLEDOCS_MIME` and `text/plain` (the alt text, or ''). Copying an image and pasting into any other app therefore yields an empty string or a stray alt caption — no `text/html` `` and no image blob. The documented parity target for this feature is Google Docs (docs/design/docs/docs-image-editing.md), where an image copy pastes as an image elsewhere. If #870's acceptance only covers in-document copy this is fine; otherwise the outcome is half delivered.
searchedFor: grep text/html and setData in packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts

samples.summary: Literal ORC character instead of the `'￼'` escape used everywhere else
samples.evidence: Every other image-inline construction in the package writes `'￼'` (editor.ts:3628, import/docx-parser.ts:69, model/types.ts:453 comment, serialize/*.ts regexes). The new block literal embeds the raw character, which greps differently and is invisible in review.

samples.summary: The #872 cell-copy fix is not reflected in the table copy/paste design doc
samples.evidence: docs-table-copy-paste.md:55 describes the copy flow as "In `handleCopy` and `handleCut`, add a branch before the existing `getSelectedBlocks()` call" and never mentions that `getSelectedBlocks()` itself must resolve cell-local block ids. The behavioural fix is real but the canonical table clipboard doc still describes the broken model; the image doc was updated for #870 while the table doc was not for #872.
